canary.description: A small download, for older computers or when disk space is low.

nemotron.name: Nemotron 3.5 Streaming
nemotron.description: Shows live text as you speak, but makes more mistakes.

dictation.title: Continuous Dictation
dictation.description: Keep talking, and the text is typed into your window each time you pause. Speech recognition stays on this computer, and AI cleanup never runs in this mode.

dragonKey.title: Dragon's Key
dragonKey.description: Use Numpad + to start and stop, as Dragon does. While it's set, that key no longer types a plus sign.

pause.title: Pause Length
pause.description: How long you pause before what you said is typed. Longer pauses keep sentences together; shorter ones show text sooner.

autoStop.title: Stop After Silence
autoStop.description: Dictation stops by itself after this long without speech, so the microphone is never left on by accident.

voiceCommands.label: Voice Commands
voiceCommands.description: Say "new paragraph" or "new line" as you talk, or "scratch that" or "stop dictation" on its own between pauses, and it acts instead of being typed. Normal sentences with these words are typed as usual.

channel.title: Input Channel
channel.description: Select which input channel to record from. Use this if your audio interface has multiple inputs.

audioFeedback.label: Audio Feedback
audioFeedback.description: Play sound when recording starts and stops

outputDevice.title: Output Device
outputDevice.description: Select your preferred audio output device for feedback sounds

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Adjust the volume of audio feedback sounds

experimentalToggle.label: Experimental Features
experimentalToggle.description: Enable experimental features that are still in development.

lazyStreamClose.label: Keep Mic Open Between Transcriptions
lazyStreamClose.description: Keeps the microphone stream open for 30 seconds after recording stops, reducing latency for back-to-back transcriptions. May degrade Bluetooth audio quality while active.

transcribe.title: Hardware Acceleration
transcribe.description: Choose the hardware used for transcription. Auto uses the GPU when available and falls back to the CPU.

startHidden.label: Start Hidden
startHidden.description: Launch to system tray without opening the window.

autostart.label: Launch on Startup
autostart.description: Automatically start Kusema when you log in to your computer.

showTrayIcon.label: Show Tray Icon
showTrayIcon.description: Display the Kusema icon in the system tray.

style.title: Overlay
style.description: Choose the recording overlay: None hides it, Minimal shows a compact pill, Live shows transcription in real time as you speak (streaming-capable models only — look for the Streaming badge in the model picker). On Linux 'None' is recommended.

position.title: Overlay Position
position.description: Where the overlay appears on screen during recording and transcription.

pasteMethod.title: Paste Method
pasteMethod.description: Choose how text is inserted. Direct: simulates typing via system input. None: skips paste, only updates history/clipboard.

typingTool.title: Typing Tool
typingTool.description: Choose which Linux typing tool to use for Direct paste method. Auto will automatically detect and use the best available tool for your system.

clipboardHandling.title: Clipboard Handling
clipboardHandling.description: Don't Modify Clipboard preserves your current clipboard contents after transcription. Copy to Clipboard leaves the transcription result in your clipboard after pasting.

autoSubmit.title: Auto Submit
autoSubmit.description: Automatically send the selected key combination after text insertion. Cmd+Enter applies on macOS, while Windows/Linux use Super+Enter.

translateToEnglish.label: Translate to English
translateToEnglish.description: Automatically translate speech from other languages to English during transcription.

modelUnload.title: Unload Model
modelUnload.description: Automatically free GPU/CPU memory when the model hasn't been used for the specified time

customWords.title: Custom Words
customWords.description: Help supported models recognize names and specialized terms. Fuzzy correction is currently limited to words using A–Z and numbers.

voiceActivityDetection.title: Voice Activity Detection
voiceActivityDetection.description: Filter silence from recordings. Streaming-capable models use a longer VAD tail; disabling VAD records raw audio.

longFormChunking.title: Long Audio Chunking
longFormChunking.description: Splits long recordings at pauses before transcribing, which typically improves transcription performance. Transcribed files and long re-transcriptions are always split.

languageDetection.title: Limit Auto to My Languages
languageDetection.description: Auto only picks from your preferred languages, using a small language detector. Turn this on if Auto keeps choosing a language you don't speak
languageDetection.downloadHint: Turning this on downloads a small language detector
languageDetection.downloadingHint: Downloading the language detector. Turn this off to cancel

vadBackend.title: Voice Activity Backend
vadBackend.description: Choose the detector used to filter silence. Earshot is experimental; switch back to Silero if speech is clipped or noise is retained.

fillerWordRemoval.title: Remove Filler Words
fillerWordRemoval.description: Removes common hesitation words from transcriptions. Turn off to keep them.

chineseScript.title: Chinese Script
chineseScript.description: Writes Mandarin and Cantonese transcriptions in Simplified characters, or in Traditional characters as written in Taiwan or Hong Kong. Other languages are left unchanged.

showAllModels.label: Show all models
showAllModels.description: List every model on the Models page, with accuracy and speed details, instead of the short list.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.description: Hold the shortcut, ask a question out loud, and Kusema answers.

provider.title: AI Provider
provider.description: Assistant mode uses the same provider and API key as Post Process.
provider.modelDescription: The model that answers your questions. Change it on the Post Process page.
provider.disabled: Assistant mode needs an AI provider (such as Anthropic, OpenAI or a local Ollama model) to answer questions. Providers are set up on the Post Process page, which appears once Post Processing is turned on. Turning it on doesn't change how normal dictation works.
provider.noProvider: Choose a provider on the Post Process page.
provider.noKey: No API key is set for {{provider}}. Add one on the Post Process page.
provider.noModel: Choose a model on the Post Process page.

screen.title: Ask About My Screen
screen.description: Ask about the window you're working in, like “What do you think of this document?” Only that window is captured, and it stays on this computer until you press Send.

confirm.label: Confirm Before Sending Screenshots
confirm.description: Show the screenshot, your question and where it will go, then wait for Send (Enter) or Cancel (Escape). Unanswered, it cancels after 30 seconds.
confirm.offWarning: Screenshots will be sent to {{provider}} as soon as you finish speaking, without showing you first. Everything visible in the window goes with them, including private or confidential information.

provider.label: Use for Screen Questions
provider.description: Send screenshots to a different provider than normal questions, for example a local vision model in Ollama for confidential documents. Follow-up questions go to the same provider until you start a new conversation.

model.label: Model for Screen Questions
model.description: A model that can see images. Leave empty to use the model chosen for this provider on the Post Process page.

conversation.empty: Ask a question with the Ask Kusema shortcut. The conversation will appear here.
conversation.noProvider: Ask Kusema needs an AI model to answer. Choose one in Settings.

voice.title: Voice
voice.previewText: Hi, I'm Kusema. This is how I'll sound when I answer your questions.

speakReplies.label: Speak Replies
speakReplies.description: Read replies aloud as they arrive. Press Cancel (Escape), start a new recording, or start a new conversation to stop.

voice.label: Voice
voice.description: Kokoro voices sound the most natural; download them above. The other voices come with your computer (on Windows, add more under Settings > Time & language > Speech).

kokoro.label: Kokoro Voices
kokoro.description: 28 natural-sounding English voices (US and UK) generated on this computer. A one-time download.
kokoro.installed: Installed. Pick a Kokoro voice below. Removing them frees the disk space; replies then use the system voice.

rate.label: Speaking Rate
rate.description: How fast replies are read. 1.00× is the voice's normal speed.

preview.label: Preview Voice
preview.description: Hear the selected voice at the selected speed.

answers.title: Typed Questions and Answers
answers.description: Type a question instead of speaking it, choose where answers go, and get step-by-step help.

answerTo.label: Answer Goes To
answerTo.description: Speak the answer, type it into the document you were working in, or both. End a question with “…and type it” or “…put it in the document” to type just that answer.

speakTyped.label: Speak Answers to Typed Questions
speakTyped.description: Read answers aloud for questions you type, too. Off, they only appear on screen.

tutor.label: Tutor Style
tutor.description: Explain step by step, check understanding, and guide you to answers instead of handing over homework answers, unless you ask for the answer. You can also say “explain step by step” in any question.
tutor.note: Follow your school's or exam's rules on AI use.

onboardingPreview.title: Preview Onboarding

historyLimit.description: Maximum number of history entries to keep

recordingRetention.description: Automatically delete old recordings to save space

alwaysOnMicrophone.description: Keep microphone active for faster response

clamshellMicrophone.title: Clamshell Microphone
clamshellMicrophone.description: Microphone to use when laptop lid is closed

postProcessingToggle.label: AI Cleanup
postProcessingToggle.description: Optional. Rewrites dictated text with an AI model when you use the AI cleanup shortcut: fixes self-corrections and grammar, keeps your meaning, and never adds facts.

appendTrailingSpace.label: Append Trailing Space
appendTrailingSpace.description: Add a space after pasted transcription

keyboardImplementation.title: Keyboard Implementation
keyboardImplementation.bindingsReset: Keyboard shortcuts were incompatible and reset to defaults

pasteDelay.title: Paste Delay (Before)
pasteDelay.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after copying text, before sending the paste keystroke. Increase if nothing gets pasted.

pasteDelayAfter.title: Paste Delay (After)
pasteDelayAfter.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after the paste keystroke, before restoring your previous clipboard. Increase if your old clipboard content is being pasted instead of the transcription.

holdThreshold.title: Hold Threshold
holdThreshold.description: Auto mode only: how long (in milliseconds) the shortcut must be held before it counts as a hold instead of a tap. Lower if short holds keep leaving recording on; raise if deliberate taps get treated as holds.

reliablePaste.title: Reliable Paste (Beta)
reliablePaste.description: Restore the clipboard only after the target app actually reads the transcription, instead of after a fixed delay. Intended to fix old clipboard content being pasted under system load. Requires a clipboard paste method; macOS and Windows only.

recordingBuffer.title: Extra Recording Buffer
recordingBuffer.description: Extra time (in milliseconds) to keep recording after you release the key, to capture trailing audio. 0 = no extra buffer.

languageDetectionWindow.title: Language Detection Audio
languageDetectionWindow.description: Seconds of speech the language detector hears. Longer is more accurate but slower.

keyboardDiagnostic.title: Keyboard Diagnostic
keyboardDiagnostic.description: Checks whether keyboard events reach Kusema. Only event counts are recorded — never which keys you press.
keyboardDiagnostic.running: Listening… press your shortcut a few times (e.g. Option+Space)
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictBlocked: Secure Input is blocking key events — keyed shortcuts cannot work until it is resolved.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictSuspicious: Modifier events arrived but no key events — something is suppressing keys even though Secure Input reports disabled. Please report this on GitHub.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictOk: Key events are reaching Kusema normally.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictNoEvents: No events captured — did you press any keys during the test?

whatsNewUpdates.label: Show What's New
whatsNewUpdates.description: Show release notes after Kusema updates

appDataDirectory.title: App Data Directory
appDataDirectory.description: Location where Kusema stores its data

ggml.title: ggml
ggml.description: High-performance tensor library for on-device machine learning inference
ggml.details: Kusema's local speech-to-text is built on transcribe.cpp and ggml. Thanks to the amazing work by Georgi Gerganov and contributors.

organizations.title: Kusema for organizations
organizations.description: Setup, support and options for firms

report.title: Report a problem or suggest a feature
report.description: Tell us on GitHub what went wrong or what you'd like

handy.title: Built on Handy
handy.description: Kusema is built on Handy by CJ Pais, used under the MIT License.

privacy.updateBlocked: Update checks are blocked in Privileged mode.

audio.title: Audio sent off this computer: 0 bytes
audio.description: Speech recognition runs on this computer, and nothing in Kusema can upload your voice. Only the text of what you say, and only for features you choose, ever goes to an AI provider.

privileged.title: Privileged Mode
privileged.description: For confidential matters. While it's on, nothing you say, type or show goes to a cloud AI service. Ask Kusema and AI cleanup only work with a model running on this computer.

toggle.label: Privileged Mode
toggle.description: Blocks every request to cloud AI providers, including ones already set up. Dictation keeps working, because it never uses the cloud.

allowLan.label: Allow Local Network AI Servers
allowLan.description: Also allows AI servers on your office network, by private address (like 192.168.1.20). Models on this computer are always allowed.

blockDownloads.label: Also Block Downloads and Update Checks
blockDownloads.description: For offline offices. Model and voice downloads and update checks carry none of your content, so they normally stay allowed and are listed below. Turn this on to stop them too while Privileged mode is on.

hotkey.label: Privileged Mode Shortcut
hotkey.description: Adds a keyboard shortcut that turns Privileged mode on or off. Off by default, so it can't be pressed by accident.

list.title: Every Request
list.description: Each request Kusema has made: when, where, why, what kind of data and how large. What was in it is never recorded. Shows the latest 500; the export has them all.

retention.title: Keep This List For
retention.description: Older entries are deleted from this computer automatically.

cleanup.title: Cleanup
cleanup.description: Dictated text should need little editing. Local cleanup runs on this computer and sends nothing anywhere.

local.label: Local Cleanup
local.description: Removes filler words, adds missing periods between phrases in continuous dictation, and handles spoken punctuation, all on this computer. Off, your words are typed as transcribed.

spokenPunctuation.label: Spoken Punctuation
spokenPunctuation.description: Say "comma", "period", "question mark", "colon", "open quote", "close paren", "dash", "section symbol" and more, as in Dragon. "Period" only counts at the end of a phrase, so "the limitations period expired" stays as words. Say "literal period" to type the word.

status.noProvider: No AI provider is set up yet.
status.local: Using {{model}} on this computer through {{provider}}. Nothing leaves this computer.
status.cloud: Using {{model}} from {{provider}}, a cloud service. Text you clean up goes to {{provider}}.
status.blocked: Privileged mode is on, so nothing will be sent to {{provider}}. Use a local model or turn off Privileged mode.

ai.recommendLocal: We recommend a model that runs on this computer, such as one in Ollama, so confidential text stays here. AI cleanup runs when you dictate with its own shortcut, and never during continuous dictation.

firstWins.title: First three wins
firstWins.newParagraph: Use continuous dictation and say "new paragraph"

glow.title: Recording indicator
glow.description: A glow around the edges of your screen shows that Kusema is listening. Only you see it: it stays out of screenshots and screen shares.

enabled.label: Screen glow
enabled.description: Show a colored glow around the screen you're working on during continuous dictation and questions. You can still click and type through it.

thickness.label: Thickness
thickness.description: How far the glow reaches in from the edge of the screen.

palette.label: Colors
palette.description: The color-blind friendly set keeps the modes easy to tell apart with every common kind of color blindness.

sounds.label: Continuous dictation sounds
sounds.description: Play a short sound when continuous dictation starts and stops. Sounds for other dictation are under Sound below.

dictation.label: Glow for Normal Dictation
dictation.description: Also show the glow while you hold the dictation shortcut. Continuous dictation and questions glow whenever the screen glow is on.

voiceEdit.title: Voice Editing
voiceEdit.description: Change text in any app by voice. Select it, hold the Kusema key and say “Kusema,” then what to do. Commands like “select last word” stay on this computer; instructions like “shorten this” go to your AI provider.

preview.label: Preview AI Edits
preview.description: Show the new text before it replaces the old. Turn off for quick edits: Ctrl+Z in the app still undoes them.

trigger.label: Trigger Word
trigger.description: Start what you say with this word to ask, edit or look at your screen instead of typing: “Kusema, make this more formal”. It works while you hold the Kusema key and in continuous dictation. Leave it empty to turn this off.

simpleKey.title: Easier Shortcut
simpleKey.description: Hold one key instead of four. Right Ctrl then no longer works as Ctrl.

packs.title: Built-in Vocabulary
packs.description: Terms Kusema writes correctly out of the box, in English dictation. Its own name is always included.

legal.label: Legal
legal.description: {{number}} Latin and legal terms, plus how citations are written: “42 U.S.C.”, “123 F.3d 456”, “Smith v. Jones”, “Rule 12(b)(6)”.

medical.label: Medical
medical.description: {{number}} drug names and clinical terms. Always review dictated medical records: a vocabulary makes recognition better, not certain.

own.title: Your Words
own.description: Names and terms you use. Add how a word is written and, if Kusema mishears it, what it writes instead.
own.addHelp: “Heard as” is what Kusema writes when it gets the word wrong, for example “Canela” for “Kanella”. Separate several with commas. Without it, close matches are corrected.

learned.title: Learned from Your Corrections
learned.description: When you fix a misheard word with “correct that” or in History, Kusema remembers it here. Learning stays on this computer.
learned.empty: Nothing learned yet. Say “correct that” after dictating to fix a misheard word.

files.title: Import and Export
files.description: Share a word list with colleagues, or bring yours over from Dragon (its exported word list, with spoken forms). Files are JSON, CSV (written, sounds like) or Dragon's text format.
files.imported: Imported {{added}} new words ({{existing}} were already there).

appStyles.title: Styles per App
appStyles.description: AI cleanup, AI voice edits and answers typed into a document follow the style of the program they go into. Only the program's name is used, on this computer. Local cleanup isn't affected.

enabled.label: Use Styles per App
enabled.description: Off, every program gets the same neutral text.

email.name: Email
email.instruction: Format it as an email: a short greeting line, brief paragraphs, and a sign-off when it's a whole message. Keep the author's voice.

formal.name: Formal
formal.instruction: Use a formal, professional tone: complete sentences, no slang, no contractions.

casual.name: Concise and casual
casual.instruction: Keep it concise and casual: short sentences and plain, friendly words, with no formal greeting or sign-off.

appStyles.name: Style name
appStyles.instructionPlaceholder: Describe the style in plain words, like “Short and friendly, no sign-off.”
appStyles.neutral: Programs that aren't listed get neutral text.

footer.portableUpdateMessage: Portable installs cannot be updated automatically. Download the installer for your system below, run it, and install to the same folder — your Data/ folder (settings, models, recordings) is kept in place.
footer.portableUpdateBrowseMessage: Portable installs cannot be updated automatically. Download the latest version for your system from GitHub Releases and install it to the same folder — your Data/ folder (settings, models, recordings) is kept in place.

micPermissionDenied.generic: Microphone access was denied by the operating system. Please grant microphone permission in your system settings.
micPermissionDenied.windows: Enable microphone access in Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone (including desktop app access).
micPermissionDenied.macos: Grant microphone access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
micPermissionDenied.linux: Grant microphone access in your system's sound or privacy settings.

errors.noInputDevice: No audio input device was detected. Please connect a microphone or headset and try again.
errors.pasteFailed: Text could not be pasted into the active application.

appLanguage.title: Application Language
appLanguage.description: Change the language of the Kusema interface

theme.title: Application Theme
theme.description: Choose whether Kusema follows your system theme or stays light or dark

dictation.noTarget: Click where the text should go
dictation.scratchOtherInput: Can't scratch: keyboard or mouse used
dictation.savedToHistory: Said while paused: saved in History
dictation.cantKeepUp: Stopped: this computer couldn't keep up
dictation.pasteFailed: Couldn't type that; it's in History

answer.waiting: Click back into your document to type the answer.
answer.noTarget: Kusema doesn't know which document this answer is for. Click in the document and ask again.
answer.windowChanged: The window changed, so the answer wasn't typed. Insert it from the Assistant page.
answer.notTyping: The paste method is set to None, so the answer wasn't typed.
answer.failed: Couldn't type the answer into this window.

overlay.triggerHint: Typed as dictation. To ask Kusema, tap Space while holding {{name}}.

screenCard.title: Send this screenshot?
screenCard.imageAlt: Screenshot of the window you asked about
screenCard.question: “{{question}}”
screenCard.onlyThis: Only this window. Nothing is sent until you press Send.

edit.title: Replace the selected text?
edit.richText: Formatting like bold or styles in the selection may be lost.
edit.keys: Enter replaces, Esc cancels. Ctrl+Z in the app undoes it.

correct.title: Correct the last dictation
correct.help: Fix it and press Enter. Kusema learns the words you change. Shift+Enter starts a new line, Esc cancels.

offer.title: Add “{{word}}” as a way to say “{{trigger}}”?
offer.body: Then anything you start with “{{word}}” goes to Kusema. Later in a sentence, the word is left as it is.

secureInput.recorderBlockedNoCulprit: macOS is temporarily blocking shortcut changes
secureInput.recorderBlocked: Can't record shortcuts right now — macOS Secure Input is blocking key events. Resolve the Secure Input warning first.

voiceCommands.title: What can I say?
voiceCommands.intro: Hold the Edit by Voice shortcut ({{shortcut}}) and say one of these, on its own. Commands marked “Also in continuous dictation” work there too when said alone.

ai.description: Select text first, or just dictate: with nothing selected, Kusema uses the last text it typed in that window. Anything that isn't a command is an instruction for your AI provider. It changes only what you ask and adds no facts.
ai.examples: “make this more formal”, “shorten to two sentences”, “turn this into bullet points”, “fix the grammar”, “translate to Spanish”
ai.privileged: In Privileged mode, only a model on this computer can be used.

voiceCommands.english: The commands are in English, whatever language Kusema is set to.
voiceCommands.support: “Select last sentence”, “select last paragraph” and “select <words>” need an app that lets Kusema read its text, such as Word, Outlook, Notepad or a text box in Chrome or Edge. The others use standard keys and work almost everywhere.

commands.selectLastWord: Selects the word before the cursor.
commands.selectLastWords: Selects that many words before the cursor, up to 50.
commands.selectLine: Selects the line the cursor is on.
commands.selectLastSentence: Selects the sentence before the cursor.
commands.selectLastParagraph: Selects the paragraph before the cursor.
commands.selectPhrase: Selects those words: the nearest match before the cursor, or the first one after.
commands.lineStart: Moves to the start of the line.
commands.lineEnd: Moves to the end of the line.
commands.documentStart: Moves to the start of the document.
commands.documentEnd: Moves to the end of the document.
commands.correctThat: Opens the last dictated text to fix by hand, and learns the words you change.

voiceCommands.trigger: During continuous dictation, start with “{{trigger}},” to change text the same way, for example “{{trigger}}, make this more formal”. Without it, everything is typed as you say it.
voiceCommands.triggerOff: To change text during continuous dictation, set a trigger word under General → Voice Editing.
voiceCommands.selectFirst: Some apps, such as ONLYOFFICE, LibreOffice and Google Docs, don't show their text to Kusema. There, select the text with the mouse or keyboard first, and selecting a sentence, paragraph or phrase by voice doesn't work.
voiceCommands.introKey: Hold {{key}} and tap Space (or start with “{{trigger}},”), then say one of these. Commands marked “Also in continuous dictation” work there when said on their own.

notice.noWindow: Click in the text you want to change, then try again.
notice.unsupported: Voice editing only works on Windows for now.
notice.selectFirst: Select the text you want to change first.
notice.noTextPattern: This app doesn't let Kusema find text by voice. Select it with the mouse or keyboard instead.
notice.nothingBefore: There's no text before the cursor.
notice.windowChanged: The window changed, so nothing was changed.
notice.selectionChanged: The selection changed, so nothing was replaced.
notice.failed: Couldn't do that in this window.
notice.noInstruction: Kusema didn't catch an instruction. Hold the shortcut while you speak.
notice.cantRead: Couldn't read the selected text in this app.
notice.cantConfirm: Couldn't tell whether anything is selected in this app, so nothing was deleted.
notice.timedOut: The preview timed out, so nothing was replaced.
notice.correctNotFound: There's nothing Kusema typed here to correct. Correct it from History instead.
notice.correctChanged: The text Kusema typed has changed since, so it can't be corrected here. Correct it from History instead.

askBox.title: Ask Kusema
askBox.screenUnavailable: Click a window first, then open this box, to ask about it.
askBox.hint: Enter asks · Shift+Enter: new line · Esc closes
askBox.noWindow: Click the window you want to ask about, then open this box again.

card.title: Kusema keys
card.ask: Tap <space/> while holding to ask Kusema, or start with <q>{{trigger}}</q>: ask, edit or look at your screen.

settings.title: Kusema Key
settings.description: One key for dictation. Hold it to talk; double-tap it for continuous dictation. To ask, edit or look at your screen, tap Space while holding it, or start with “Kusema”. Other apps never see the key.

enabled.label: Use the Kusema Key
enabled.description: Off, only the shortcuts below work.

key.label: Key
key.description: Right Ctrl suits most keyboards. Laptops without one often have a Copilot key. Numpad + is Dragon's microphone key. The key you choose stops doing anything else.

settings.copilotSuggest: This keyboard has a Copilot key, and Kusema hasn't seen a Right Ctrl. Use the Copilot key instead?
settings.laptopHint: No Right Ctrl on this laptop? Choose the Copilot key, or press the key you want.

classic.label: Classic Shortcuts
classic.description: Also keep a separate shortcut for each action (Ctrl+Space to dictate, Ctrl+Alt+Space to ask and so on), alongside the Kusema key.

refusal.types: That key types something, so it can't be the Kusema key. Choose a spare key, like Right Ctrl, Pause or a function key.
refusal.needed: That key is needed for other things. Choose a spare key, like Right Ctrl, Pause or a function key.
refusal.moves: That key moves the cursor. Choose a spare key, like Right Ctrl, Pause or a function key.

news.title: New: simpler keys
news.body: Kusema now has one key instead of many shortcuts. These are the only two rules:
news.keptClassic: Kusema now has one key for everything. You had changed a shortcut, so your shortcuts still work too. Turn them off under Classic Shortcuts if you like.
